server_command: python3 -m tools.harness run playable --client java --server-variant v2
client_requirement: A vanilla 26.1.2 real client must connect to playable.toml through the repo-native Gradle runClient adapter; protocol harnesses do not satisfy this gate, and prepared artifacts are not passing evidence.

steps: Connect a real vanilla client to playable.toml through the playable runner.
Run the no-debug natural wood -> crafting table -> wooden pickaxe path.
Wait for natural night without commands, scan loaded hostile entities for a naturally spawned zombie, and approach it through normal movement.
Select the earned wooden pickaxe, attack the zombie until it dies, collect the visible rotten flesh drop, and capture a screenshot.
expected_observations: The client-agent scenario uses no debug give, summon, teleport, time, damage, or chat-command setup.
The real client reaches night through normal world time and finds a naturally loaded zombie.
The real client kills the zombie using the earned wooden pickaxe and restores at least one rotten flesh item through visible item-entity pickup.

steps: Connect a real vanilla client to playable.toml through the playable runner.
Run the no-debug natural wood -> crafting table -> wooden pickaxe path.
Mine two natural stone blocks with the earned wooden pickaxe, reopen the earned crafting table, and craft a stone sword from earned cobblestone and sticks.
Wait for natural night without commands, scan loaded hostile entities for a naturally spawned zombie, and approach it through normal movement.
Select the earned stone sword, attack the zombie until it dies, collect the visible rotten flesh drop, and capture a screenshot.
expected_observations: The client-agent scenario uses no debug give, summon, teleport, time, damage, or chat-command setup.
The real client crafts minecraft:stone_sword from earned cobblestone and sticks using embedded recipe display id 26.
The real client kills a naturally loaded zombie using the earned stone sword and restores at least one rotten flesh item through visible item-entity pickup.

steps: Connect a real vanilla client to playable.toml through the playable runner.
Run the no-debug natural wood -> crafting table -> wooden pickaxe -> stone pickaxe -> furnace path.
Mine and smelt two natural iron ore drops into two earned iron ingots, craft sticks from earned planks when needed, and craft an earned iron sword.
Stop Solaris with the runner-managed graceful restart path, restart the same world, reconnect the same real client, and capture screenshots for both phases.
Verify the crafted table marker persists and the earned iron sword remains in the player inventory after restart.
expected_observations: The client-agent scenario uses no debug give, summon, teleport, time, damage, or chat-command setup.
The before phase records iron sword recipe evidence and a runner-managed restart marker.
The after phase observes the persisted crafting table marker and at least one minecraft:iron_sword in inventory.

steps: Connect a real vanilla client to playable.toml through the playable runner.
Run the no-debug natural wood -> crafting table -> wooden pickaxe -> stone pickaxe -> furnace path.
Mine and smelt one natural iron ore drop into one earned iron ingot, keep earned planks, and reopen the earned crafting table.
Craft a shield from earned planks and the earned iron ingot using embedded recipe display id 58.

Wait for natural night without commands, scan loaded hostile entities for a naturally spawned zombie, select the earned shield, hold use while facing the zombie until a shield-damage packet proves that an attack was blocked, and capture a screenshot.
expected_observations: The client-agent scenario uses no debug give, summon, teleport, time, damage, or chat-command setup.
The real client crafts minecraft:shield from six earned planks and one earned minecraft:iron_ingot using embedded recipe display id 58.

The real client requires an actual server-sent shield block event with unchanged player health; elapsed time or absence of an attack cannot satisfy the scenario. Shield wear is recorded, not required for a sub-three-damage vanilla block.

steps: Connect a real vanilla client to playable.toml through the playable runner.
Run the no-debug natural wood -> crafting table -> wooden pickaxe -> stone pickaxe -> furnace path.
Collect extra natural logs for earned plank fuel, then mine and smelt eight natural iron ore drops into eight earned iron ingots.
Craft and quick-equip the earned iron chestplate through the normal inventory path.
Wait for natural night without commands, scan loaded hostile entities for a naturally spawned zombie, approach it through normal movement, wait for a natural melee hit, and capture a screenshot.
expected_observations: The client-agent scenario uses no debug give, summon, teleport, time, damage, or chat-command setup.
The real client observes the earned iron chestplate in the chest armor slot before hostile contact.
A naturally loaded zombie hit reduces player health by no more than the iron-chestplate mitigation threshold, proving armor affects survival damage instead of only rendering as equipped.

steps: Connect a real vanilla client to playable.toml through the playable runner.
Run the no-debug natural wood -> crafting table -> wooden pickaxe -> stone pickaxe -> furnace path.
Mine and smelt eight natural iron ore drops into eight earned iron ingots, craft and quick-equip an earned iron chestplate, then write the crafted table restart marker.
Stop Solaris with the runner-managed graceful restart path, restart the same world, reconnect the same real client, and capture screenshots for both phases.
Verify the crafted table marker persists, verify the earned iron chestplate remains in the chest armor slot, wait for natural night, and measure a natural zombie melee hit after restart.
expected_observations: The client-agent scenario uses no debug give, summon, teleport, time, damage, or chat-command setup.
The before phase records iron chestplate equip evidence and a runner-managed restart marker.
The after phase observes the persisted crafting table marker, the persisted chest armor slot, and a post-restart zombie hit below the iron-chestplate mitigation threshold.

steps: Connect the vanilla graphical client as an operator; inspect its received Brigadier command roots.
Open chat with /gam and press Tab; capture suggestions and the completed /gamemode input.
Run /gamemode creative and /give @s minecraft:diamond 3; observe native game mode and inventory.
Return to survival and self-deop; require the refreshed command tree to hide gamemode.
Send gamemode and give as a non-op; capture the vanilla refusal message and unchanged mode/inventory.
expected_observations: The client's command tree is non-empty and its native chat completion offers gamemode.
Creative mode and exactly three diamonds are observed in received client state.
Non-op commands produce Unknown or incomplete command without applying their effects.
Each assertion has a named screenshot; setup uses vanilla operator commands, never debug commands.

steps: Run /scoreboard objectives add k dummy and /scoreboard objectives setdisplay sidebar k.
Run /scoreboard players set @s k 5.
Run /team add red, /team modify red color red and /team join red @s.
Capture a screenshot after each command converges in the client's received scoreboard.
expected_observations: Native client Scoreboard contains objective k, sidebar selects k and self score is five.
Native client PlayerTeam red is red and contains the local player.
Sidebar is visible in screenshots; assertions inspect vanilla state, not command success strings.

steps: Use vanilla /give to provide one golden apple and consume it with the client's native use action.
Open inventory and capture active absorption/regeneration effect state.
Give and drink milk; capture the empty active effect collection.
Run /effect give @s speed 30 1 and capture active Speed II plus movement_speed attribute.
expected_observations: Native golden-apple consumption debits exactly one item in a fresh authoritative inventory packet and produces active absorption.
Milk debits exactly one item in a fresh authoritative inventory packet and clears active effects.
The client's movement_speed attribute is baseline times 1.4 with Speed II.
Screenshots show the inventory effect UI for each stage.

steps: Use vanilla operator commands to prepare a loaded stone pad, fifteen bookshelves, tool, lapis and forty XP levels; place each station via native item use.
Open the enchanting table and insert the diamond pickaxe and three lapis using native container transfers.
Observe all three positive costs/enchantment clues/levels in EnchantmentMenu; select the first offer and observe enchantments and XP debit.
Natively place the anvil three blocks to the side, outside the bookshelf ring; enter UI Smoke Pick in its name field and take the server-confirmed renamed enchanted result.

Natively place the grindstone three blocks to the opposite side, outside the bookshelf ring; observe an unenchanted result, take it and require newly visible positive-value vanilla ExperienceOrb entities.
Capture each placed station, menu, offer/result and final received inventory state.
expected_observations: All three native station screens open from placed world blocks.
Three real enchanting offers appear, and the taken pickaxe has received enchantments.
Anvil rename is confirmed by a changed received container state id, then persists in inventory.
Grindstone removes enchantments, preserves the rename and spawns visible XP orb entities.
Operator setup is explicitly not evidence of natural material/XP acquisition.

steps: Run one bounded adjacent-behavior pass in a fresh graphical client.
Reject a zero-count diamond give without inventory credit and retain feedback.
Add duplicate objective k without replacing/duplicating the native objective.
Join, leave and remove team red; observe membership and team removal.
Apply stronger then weaker speed; require no stacked multiplier, then drink milk and observe baseline restoration.
Capture screenshots for each assertion and retain severity-ranked findings in the QA report.
expected_observations: Invalid give does not credit inventory; duplicate scoreboard add preserves the original objective.
Team leave/removal clears the corresponding native client state.
Weaker speed does not overwrite the stronger active effect or stack its attribute modifier.
Milk's exact one-item debit requires a fresh authoritative inventory packet; it clears hidden/active effects and restores movement_speed exactly to baseline.

steps: In an isolated fresh operator-enabled v2 world, use a villager spawn egg and place a workstation natively.
Wait for the received villager profession, then set and require received night so vanilla restock cannot reset offer uses; open MerchantScreen and inspect MerchantOffers.
Supply the required trade materials, execute exactly one native result take, close and reopen the same merchant.
expected_observations: Client profession and MerchantOffers are received; no profession or trade outcome is injected.
Exact input debit and output credit occur once, and remaining uses decrease by one after reopening.
Every assertion captures a named vanilla-client screenshot; operator materials are not natural-acquisition evidence.

steps: Prepare unpowered isolated circuits; natively activate lever, button and hopper input transfer.
Observe lever-wire-repeater-lamp propagation and button-driven piston extension then retraction.
Observe an exact hopper-chain chest transfer and the comparator reading the chest.
expected_observations: Received wire/repeater/lamp and piston states follow native activations.
Source and intermediate inventories empty, destination counts remain exact with no duplicate credit.
Comparator output reflects received chest contents; screenshots accompany each step.

steps: Native-fill a supplied empty glass bottle at a declared water source; place/open a stand and insert that water potion plus supplied nether wart and blaze powder.
Observe received fuel/progress and wait for brewing completion.
Take the awkward potion using the native container transfer.
expected_observations: Water potion becomes an awkward potion in received PotionContents, not merely an unchanged potion item id.
Ingredient/fuel consumption and exactly one taken result converge in the vanilla inventory.
Screenshots capture placement, active brewing, completed result and result take.

steps: Use operator-provided equipment to shoot a mob natively with a bow and collect an arrow.
Load and fire a crossbow, throw a loyalty trident and await its return.
Throw an ender pearl and observe the resulting player teleport.
expected_observations: The client's mob health decreases after the bow impact and arrow pickup credits exactly once.
Crossbow charged-projectile component changes and projectile entity appears; thrown trident returns exactly once.
Pearl debit and received player displacement are observed; screenshots accompany each step.

steps: Cast an operator-provided fishing rod natively into a prepared valid water fixture.
Wait within a bounded fishing timeout for received FishingHook bite state.
Reel natively and observe received inventory loot.
expected_observations: A client fishing hook is observed, then its bite state, then removal after reel.
Exactly one fishing loot credit is observed without operator-generated bite or loot.
Screenshots capture cast, bite and collected item.

steps: Capture baseline client block light, place a torch natively and observe nearby light increase.
Ignite prepared TNT with native flint-and-steel use; observe priming and explosion removal.
Ignite a flammable fixture natively, observe spread to a previously unlit location, then extinguish.
expected_observations: Received BLOCK light rises, not just sky light or torch block presence.
PrimedTnt appears and previously received solid fixture blocks are removed by explosion.
Received fire spreads and disappears after extinguishing; each stage has a screenshot.

steps: Place/open stonecutter, smithing table and loom through native block use.
Execute one stonecutter recipe, netherite smithing upgrade and loom banner pattern with supplied materials.
Insert a guaranteed-compostable item natively and observe composter level increment.
expected_observations: Each received recipe result has exact input consumption and one output credit.
Smithing output is the upgraded item and loom output has the received banner-pattern component.
Composter LEVEL increments; screenshots accompany station opening, recipes and outputs.

steps: Native bones tame wolf; BLUE dye changes the default-RED collar, then sit/stand; lead, saddle, mount/dismount pig.
expected_observations: Received tame, collar, sitting, leash and passengers; bone/dye/lead/saddle debits require fresh authoritative inventory packets. No steer/horse parity claim.

steps: Mount/dismount minecart and boat; native boat forward input.
expected_observations: Received passenger links and cleared links; a fresh server-relative teleport pose proves boat movement reached server custody, not only local prediction. No powered-rail parity claim.

steps: Live blaze fires; summon declared no-AI pillager, witch, breeze, shulker and ghast.
expected_observations: Received small_fireball from live blaze and exact tracked species; remaining species AI is a gap.

steps: Ignite obsidian frame natively and enter via declared teleport.
expected_observations: Received portal, one durability debit and Nether dimension transition; reverse travel is not covered.

steps: Contact declared End portal; teleport/load central chunk, declare one-chunk supported arena and require received floor; observe dragon; set End spawn, die and respawn.
expected_observations: Received End, central supported arena, dragon and alive End respawn coordinates; no eye activation or dragon kill claim.

steps: Native crafter toggle, reopen, input one log and command a redstone pulse.
expected_observations: Reopened disabled slot, one four-plank ejection, input slot empty.

steps: Native diamond deposit/withdraw from oak shelf.
expected_observations: Received shelf BE custody and exact inventory debit/credit; forty-tick no duplicate fence.

steps: Deposit and reopen copper chest; withdraw; summon copper golem.
expected_observations: Exact three-diamond conservation and received copper golem; sorting AI is a gap.

steps: Approach declared trial spawner and vault; use key, then repeat after reward.
expected_observations: Spawner registration state, vault unlocking with one key debit, repeat no debit.

steps: Harvest full smoked hive natively; live bee pollinates declared flower and enters hive; native hive destruction releases it.
expected_observations: One honey bottle, hive honey=0, nectar metadata, bee removal and same UUID reappearing once after native break; natural timed exit remains a gap.

steps: Native allay held diamond/return; native disc insertion/ejection.
expected_observations: Exact held-stack conservation, received jukebox record and dance transitions; fetch and duplication gaps.

steps: Native baby-pig flower toggle, rejected cooldown use, later unlock.
expected_observations: Received lock bit and exact two successful one-flower debits; cooldown refuses mutation.

steps: Charge native mace, fall >2.5 blocks and attack fixture golem.
expected_observations: Received damage greater than the critical-only ceiling nine and player survives landing; enchantments are gaps.

steps: Build 42-cell water frame; swim near dolphin; remove conduit.
expected_observations: Native Conduit Power, Dolphin Grace and later conduit effect expiry; attack-target parity gap.

steps: Native lever vibration, shrieker contact, declared warden summon.
expected_observations: Received sensor active/inactive, shrieking, warden and Darkness; natural warden emergence gap.

steps: Occupied bed/bell/villager fixture with declared resistance-five observer/villager protection and Bad Omen; observe three easy waves, script clears.
expected_observations: Native Raid Omen conversion and Hero after victory; scripted clear is not earned combat.

steps: Declared flower/live bee/full hive and supplied silk axe; native survival mining and pickup.
Native diamond deposit into shulker, mine filled box and pick up.
Native cursor pickup/deposit/withdraw/return through chest and rejected nested-shulker deposit.
expected_observations: Received silk hive retains one bee and honey level five; received filled shulker retains exactly three diamonds.
Every accepted/refused click requires a fresh raw received authoritative menu image with exact affected slots and carried cursor components, plus client convergence.
Fresh reopened menu and stable custody fence exclude duplicated hive/box/loose diamonds. No changed-slot or carried hash-proof reconciliation assertion.
